# Void

Void is a dark theme built on black and gray with deliberately subtle contrast. Its recorded description names soft text, restrained accents and minimal UI elements as the way it reduces visual noise while writing, reading and organizing notes.

![Void screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0crazy-0/obsidian-void/HEAD/img/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Void"
    author: "0Crazy-0"
    repo:   "0crazy-0/obsidian-void"
    slug:   "void"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/void"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/0crazy-0/obsidian-void"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0crazy-0/obsidian-void/HEAD/img/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Create a calm, distraction-free workspace with a dark black-and-gray palette and subtle contrast. Reduce visual noise with soft text, restrained accents, and minimal UI elements for comfortable writing, reading, and organizing notes."
}
```
